title: AI Resume & Job Description Matcher with Interview Question Generator
tagline: Takes a PDF resume + target JD and generates match score, gap analysis, and 5 tailored behavioral questions.
problemStatement: Engineering students get rejected by ATS scanners without knowing why their resume failed keyword and skill matching.
architecture: React frontend -> LLM Parser (Gemini API) -> Structured JSON output with ATS score and suggested improvements.
workshopFit: Built and deployed in 40 minutes using React and Gemini API.
interviewTalkingPoint: Demonstrates prompt engineering, structured JSON parsing, and handling file uploads with client-side state.

title: Git Commit Diff Explainer & Automated PR Release Notes Bot
tagline: Paste any Git diff or code change to produce semantic human-readable release notes and unit test suggestions.
problemStatement: Developers waste hours writing changelogs and pull request summaries for engineering standups.
architecture: Git Diff parser -> Context-aware LLM prompt -> Markdown formatted PR summary with risk score.
workshopFit: Teaches context window management and code syntax highlighting.
interviewTalkingPoint: Highlights deep understanding of developer workflows and CI/CD automation.

title: Natural Language to SQL Query & Schema Safety Analyzer
tagline: Type questions in plain English ('Show students with CGPA > 8.5 who missed Day 1') and receive validated SQL queries.
problemStatement: Non-technical stakeholders and junior devs struggle with complex multi-table SQL joins.
architecture: DB Schema context injection -> Few-shot prompt -> SQL Generator with destructive command validation.
workshopFit: Explains system prompting and input sanitization to prevent accidental DROP TABLE commands.
interviewTalkingPoint: Proves knowledge of relational databases, query execution safety, and few-shot LLM guidance.

title: Automated YouTube Technical Tutorial Summarizer & Quiz Generator
tagline: Paste any coding lecture transcript to get structured concept bullet points and a 5-question self-assessment test.
problemStatement: Students spend 3 hours watching video playlists when they only need core architectural principles.
architecture: Transcript ingestion -> Recursive text chunking -> LLM concept extraction and interactive quiz component.
workshopFit: Ideal 60-minute project demonstrating text transformation and interactive UI state.
interviewTalkingPoint: Shows mastery of retrieval chunking, token optimization, and dynamic quiz state machines.

title: Smart API Security & Hardcoded Secret Detector
tagline: Scans code snippets for leaked API keys, unprotected endpoints, and SQL injection vulnerabilities.
problemStatement: Student code repositories frequently leak AWS or Supabase keys onto public GitHub.
architecture: Regex credential pattern matcher -> LLM security vulnerability auditor -> Remediation recommendation.
workshopFit: Directly relevant to workshop safety guidelines and secure API key management.
interviewTalkingPoint: Differentiates candidates on enterprise security awareness and secure software development lifecycle.

title: Natural Language IoT Device Rule Engine & Home Automation Agent
tagline: Converts everyday English instructions into MQTT commands and Arduino/ESP32 micro-logic rules.
problemStatement: Connecting hardware sensors to dynamic logical triggers usually requires manual firmware recompilation.
architecture: Sensor telemetry schema -> LLM intent classifier -> MicroPython / C++ actuation command generator.
workshopFit: Shows how software LLMs bridge the gap between high-level reasoning and low-level embedded hardware.
interviewTalkingPoint: Proves ability to bridge hardware circuits and modern cloud AI APIs.

title: AI Audio Noise Classifier & Sensor Signal Anomaly Detector
tagline: Analyzes noisy sensor wave data to classify anomalous spikes, interference patterns, and telemetry health.
problemStatement: Hardware engineers spend hours eyeballing oscilloscope and serial monitor logs for signal degradation.
architecture: Time-series signal array -> Statistical feature extractor -> LLM diagnostic advisor with confidence interval.
workshopFit: Transforms standard ECE signal analysis into a modern AI diagnosis tool.
interviewTalkingPoint: Demonstrates DSP knowledge combined with heuristic AI reasoning.

title: Verilog & VHDL Syntax Explainer & Testbench Generator
tagline: Takes digital logic module definitions and automatically drafts Verilog testbench vectors and edge cases.
problemStatement: Writing comprehensive hardware testbenches for FPGAs is tedious and prone to missing edge clock cycles.
architecture: Verilog module port definition -> LLM combinatorial analyzer -> Structured testbench code generation.
workshopFit: Combines digital electronics theory with modern generative engineering tools.
interviewTalkingPoint: Proves deep grasp of finite state machines, clock timing, and automated verification.

title: Solar Inverter Fault Diagnostic & Power Yield Forecaster
tagline: Takes voltage, current, and temperature sensor readings to diagnose photovoltaic string faults.
problemStatement: Rooftop solar arrays lose up to 18% efficiency due to undetected shading, dust accumulation, or diode failure.
architecture: Current-Voltage curve data -> Heuristic diagnostic engine -> Plain-English maintenance instructions.
workshopFit: Hands-on workshop project bridging green energy transition with AI decision support.
interviewTalkingPoint: Combines electrical power engineering with predictive maintenance.

title: EV Battery State-of-Health (SoH) & Thermal Runaway Early Warning Assistant
tagline: Monitors lithium-ion cell voltages and thermistor readings to compute battery degradation risks.
problemStatement: Battery management systems require rapid, explainable diagnostics to prevent thermal emergencies.
architecture: Cell telemetry log -> Anomaly classifier -> Instant emergency response protocol and driver advisory.
workshopFit: High recruiter interest in automotive and clean tech engineering domains.
interviewTalkingPoint: Demonstrates knowledge of BMS architecture and safety-critical software engineering.

title: CNC Tool Wear & Vibration Anomaly Diagnostic Assistant
tagline: Processes accelerometer logs from milling machines to predict tool failure before workpiece damage.
problemStatement: Unplanned cutting tool breakage causes expensive scrap and assembly line stoppages.
architecture: Vibration frequency inputs -> LLM diagnostic synthesis -> Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation.
workshopFit: Accessible mechanical domain project requiring zero physical lab equipment to prototype.
interviewTalkingPoint: Bridges Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, and software engineering in interviews.

title: Heat Exchanger Efficiency Calculator & Thermal Loss Explainer
tagline: Takes fluid temperatures and flow rates to calculate heat transfer coefficients and recommend insulation.
problemStatement: Mechanical engineers manually recalculate thermodynamic tables during HVAC and engine tuning.
architecture: Thermal balance equation solver -> LLM diagnostic commentary and energy conservation recommendations.
workshopFit: Clear input/output structure that can be built and deployed in 30 minutes.
interviewTalkingPoint: Shows recruiters you can write production software for core mechanical physics problems.

title: Concrete Crack Severity Classifier & Structural Inspection Assistant
tagline: Upload crack descriptions or dimensional measurements to assess structural hazard levels per IS 456.
problemStatement: Field structural inspections require immediate classification between surface hairline cracks and structural shear failures.
architecture: Crack width/orientation context -> Structural safety prompt -> Remediation urgency score.
workshopFit: Transforms traditional civil site inspections into a modern digital platform.
interviewTalkingPoint: Demonstrates application of national building standards with intelligent software tooling.

title: AI Technical Interview Coach with Dynamic Follow-up Probing
tagline: Conducts a simulated 5-minute technical interview tailored to your target company and grades your answers.
problemStatement: Students fail campus interviews not from lack of coding knowledge, but from unstructured verbal communication.
architecture: Role & company context -> LLM interviewer persona -> Multi-turn dialogue with instant communication rubric.
workshopFit: Built live during the 60-minute workshop; students can immediately use it on themselves.
interviewTalkingPoint: Self-referential project demonstrating conversational state, prompt chaining, and evaluation metrics.

title: Smart Cold Email & LinkedIn Pitch Personalizer for Recruiters
tagline: Generates concise, non-spammy outreach emails citing specific company projects and matching candidate skills.
problemStatement: Engineering students send generic copy-paste LinkedIn messages that recruiters delete immediately.
architecture: Recruiter profile text + Student project summary -> LLM personalization prompt -> 3 tone variations.
workshopFit: Quick 25-minute build that delivers immediate real-world career utility.
interviewTalkingPoint: Shows understanding of persona-driven copywriting and token-efficient generative models.
